caseStudies.title: AI Co-Pilot for Cybersecurity Threat Detection
caseStudies.description: SOC analysts needed excessive time to deploy protections against threats relevant to their organization and industry. Copods redesigned the detection-engineering workflow around a no-code protection builder and an AI co-pilot.
goals: Democratize the cybersecurity protection process by lowering the barrier to entry
Modernize the visual language and component system
solution: No-code protection builder with drag-and-drop interface
1-click protection deployment for critical breach situations
Co-Pilot AI assistant for event explanation, report writing, hunt assistance, and protection building
Redesigned navigation structure and optimized task flows
Standardized design system with Storybook components; migrated UI library from MUI4 to MUI5
caseStudies.results: 40% efficiency gain; 3x faster protection creation; 5x faster deployment; $20M sales revenue increase in 2024

caseStudies.title: MVP for a Supply Chain Optimization Platform
caseStudies.description: Manufacturing organizations needed to optimize supply-chain processes, identify bottlenecks, and accelerate operational decision-making. Copods layered intuitive UI/UX on top of ThroughPut's Supply Chain Optimization AI engine.
audience: Supply chain professionals and decision-makers in manufacturing operations
goals: Release an MVP enabling bottleneck tracking and operational agility for early market adoption
Give users a single source of truth for end-to-end supply-chain visibility
solution: ABC-XYZ Matrix for demand sensing and planning across manufacturing, logistics, and finance
Outbound/Inbound Material Flow visualization using Sankey diagrams and maps
Critical Constraint Resource (CCR) analysis to optimize manufacturing parameters

caseStudies.title: Customer Feedback & Analytics Platform Redesign
caseStudies.description: Product builders struggled to understand the reasoning behind customer feedback and lacked tools to prioritize issues efficiently; search and query were the most-complained-about part of the product.
audience: Product builders and teams analyzing customer feedback at scale
goals: Help product teams comprehend customer feedback quickly
Establish a clear prioritization framework for customer concerns
Fix the highest-complaint search and query experience
solution: Chart builder for visualizing feedback across metrics with comparative analysis
Revamped search and query builder
Customizable dashboards and subscription workflows for feedback monitoring
Support for multiple feedback types: audio, forum threads, support conversations, file uploads
AI-powered chatbot for natural-language queries with inspectable, user-modifiable responses
Multimodal AI outputs (text, charts, records) and cross-touchpoint feedback summarization

caseStudies.title: Order Management Platform Redesign
caseStudies.description: The platform had a convoluted order-processing system with hidden actions and inefficient workflows, making it hard for users to identify actionable orders, manage delays, and navigate across channels and warehouses.
audience: Order-management platform users: order fulfillment, inventory administration, marketplace operations across channels and warehouses
goals: Streamline order processing and reduce cognitive load
Improve workflow efficiency and enable faster order resolution
Give users complete visibility into order state across channels
solution: Redesigned navigation grouping orders by status
Workbench approach for managing delays and surfacing actionable orders
Embedded grids for instant product details
Prominent suggestive actions for every order and product
Complete order overview: current state, errors, shipment details
Dedicated task hub for issue resolution
Conversational interface for order status, alerts, and prompts
caseStudies.results: Streamlined multi-channel order management with a redesigned workbench and task-hub model
